preferencesSubtitle: Control which notifications you receive and how they are delivered. Mandatory alerts cannot be disabled.
preferencesSaveError: Failed to save preferences. Please try again.
inAppDesc: Choose which alerts appear inside CAFA PMIS. All enabled items show in the notification bell.
emailDesc: Email delivery depends on your organisation's mail server configuration. Mandatory emails cannot be disabled.
emailVerificationRequired: Email notifications are unavailable until your email address is verified. Mandatory security emails remain active.
deliveryChannelDesc: Controls optional notifications. Mandatory security and critical alerts are still delivered through their required channels.
deliveryEmailOnlyDesc: Nothing shown in the notification bell
digestDesc: Group notifications into a summary instead of individual alerts. Daily and weekly delivery will be available in a future release.
digestImmediateDesc: Each notification is delivered as it happens
quietHoursDesc: Suppress email delivery during these hours. Mandatory alerts (critical risks and security) are still delivered.
quietHoursEnableDesc: No emails sent during the specified window
quietHoursTimezoneReadOnly: Timezone is taken from your profile settings.
